sentences.text: Apocopodon was a cartilaginous fish belonging to the class Chondrichthyes.
It is a member of the family Myliobatidae, which includes modern stingrays.
The genus contains only one known species, A. sericeus.
The genus was first described from fossils found in the Danian-aged Marina Farinha Formation in Brazil.
Fossils were recently reported in Kingstree, South Carolina, from the lower Paleocene Rhems Formation, expanding its known geographic range.
Its time range is listed as the Cenomanian to Maastrichtian, from 100.5 to 66 million years ago.
